name: Semester wrapped
summary: The group's semester recap as a pack of six cards each person rips open, flips and shares.
useWhen: end of a term and the group wants a recap of its own stats
someone asks for a 'wrapped' of the group chat
dontUseWhen: no real numbers were given: never invent stats

params.cards: 1 to 6 cards: kind (study|food|chat|music|night|squad), title, big (the number as text), unit, who (person, place or song), detail (one fact)
params.opened: names of people who already opened theirs
